teaser.en: Eat a handful of these dark berries and your tongue turns purple for the rest of the afternoon.
teaser.sw: Ukila konzi moja ya matunda haya meusi, ulimi wako hubaki wa zambarau mchana wote.
teaser.dg: Uchirya matunda gaga maru mkpwono mmwenga, lilimiro rindagaluka rangi ya zambarau hadi dziloni.

summary.en: *Mzambarau* is the Java plum or jambolan, an evergreen tree of homesteads and wet places with purple-black fruits. The fruit is eaten fresh, and stains the tongue a deep purple.
summary.sw: *Mzambarau* ni mzambarau, mti usiopukutisha majani unaoota kuzunguka makazi na sehemu zenye unyevu, wenye matunda ya rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi. Tunda huliwa likiwa bichi, na hutia ulimi rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea.
summary.dg: *Mzambarau* ni *Java plum* au *jambolan* kpwa Chingereza, muhi wenye makodza chila wakati umerao midzini na phatu phenye madzi, na una matunda ga zambarau-nyiru. Matundage nkuriwa dza garivyo, na ganahenda lilimi rikale zambarau sana.

about.en:
*Mzambarau* is an evergreen tree with smooth, glossy, leathery leaves that smell faintly of turpentine when crushed. The small, fluffy white flowers are mostly stamens, as in other members of the myrtle family.

The fruits are oval berries that ripen from green through pink to a glossy purple-black. They are juicy and astringent, with a single seed inside.
about.sw:
*Mzambarau* ni mti usiopukutisha majani, wenye majani laini, yanayong'aa na magumu kama ngozi, ambayo hutoa harufu hafifu ya tapentaini yanapopondwa. Maua yake madogo meupe yanayofanana na pamba kwa sehemu kubwa ni stameni, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya familia ya mihadasi.

Matunda ni beri zenye umbo la yai ambazo huiva kutoka kijani, kupitia waridi, hadi zambarau-nyeusi inayong'aa. Yana maji mengi na ladha ya kukwaruza kinywani, na mbegu moja ndani.
about.dg:
*Mzambarau* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ni laini, ganang'ala, na ni mafu dza chingo; gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu chidide ya tapentaini. Maruwage ni madide, mereru na laini dza pamba; manji ni stameni, dza irivyo kpwa mimea yanjina ya jamii ya *myrtle*.

Matundage ni madide na ganahalana na tumbi kpwa sura. Ganaivwa kula chijani, chisha pinki, hadi zambarau-nyiru inayong'ala. Gana madzi manji na ganakaraza mromoni, na chila tunda rina tembe mwenga ndani.

where.en: It grows around homesteads and in wet places, such as along streams and in low-lying ground.
where.sw: Huota kuzunguka makazi na katika sehemu zenye unyevu, kama vile kando ya vijito na kwenye maeneo ya chini.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya midzi na phatu phenye madzi, dza kanda-kanda ya miho midide na phatu pha photsi.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten fresh, and its dark juice stains the tongue purple.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa likiwa bichi, na maji yake meusi hutia ulimi rangi ya zambarau.
uses.dg: Matundage nkuriwa dza garivyo, na madzige maru ganahenda lilimi rikale zambarau.

names.en: The Digo name is *mzambarau*, the same as in Swahili and Giriama; the Swahili word for the fruit is *zambarau*. In English it is Java plum or jambolan. The name *mzambarau* is also used for the native water berry, *Syzygium guineense*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mzambarau*, sawa na la Kiswahili na Kigiriama; neno la Kiswahili kwa tunda ni *zambarau*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Java plum* au *jambolan*. Jina *mzambarau* pia hutumika kwa mzambarau wa asili wa maeneo yenye maji, *Syzygium guineense*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mzambarau*, sawa na kpwa Chiswahili na Chigiryama; kpwa Chiswahili tundare ni *zambarau*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Java plum* au *jambolan*. Dzina *mzambarau* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa muhi wa chienyeji wa *water berry*, *Syzygium guineense*.

reason.en: Same genus; the native water berry shares its name
reason.sw: Wa jenasi moja; mzambarau wa asili wa maeneo yenye maji, unaoshiriki jina lake
reason.dg: Jenasi mwenga; muhi wa chienyeji wa *water berry* piya unaihwa *mzambarau*.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa matunda wa nyumbani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa matunda wa midzini.
